title: Kissed German Macaroni Pasta
description: A twist on traditional German macaroni pasta featuring a fresh and springy long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a low-sodium-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use the unsalted butter to keep the dish low-sodium

instructions: Prepare the homemade long-fermentation-dough according to the recipe below.
Bring a large pot of salt-free water to a boil and cook the macaroni for 8-10 minutes, or until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the garlic powder (if using) and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked macaroni to the skillet and toss with the melted butter and garlic powder (if using).
In a separate saucepan, warm the milk over low heat.
Add the shredded Gruyère cheese to the warmed milk and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the melted cheese mixture to the macaroni and toss to coat.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and well combined.
Season the macaroni with black pepper to taste.
Transfer the macaroni to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley.
